## Common WHERE Filters

分区过滤（几乎每个查询都用）：
```sql
WHERE grass_region = '<REGION>'
  AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
```

BR 写过滤（排除 Platform 维度）：
```sql
WHERE grass_region = 'BR'
  AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
  AND common_feature != 'Platform'
```

维度表构建过滤（只取有效 key）：
```sql
WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}'
  AND grass_date = DATE '${ISO_YESTERDAY}'
  AND item_id IS NOT NULL
  AND shop_id IS NOT NULL
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### 下游表 FULL OUTER JOIN（补充 omni 全渠道指标）

ads_seller_key_metrics 粒度 (shop + scene):
```sql
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, scene,
        SUM(ads_imp_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
        SUM(total_imp) AS total_imp,
        SUM(ads_click_cnt) AS ads_clk_cnt,
        SUM(total_click) AS total_clk,
        SUM(ads_order_cnt) AS ads_order_cnt,
        SUM(total_order) AS total_order,
        SUM(ads_gmv_usd) AS ads_gmv_usd,
        SUM(total_gmv) AS total_gmv,
        SUM(total_atc) AS total_add_to_cart_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id,
            ads_imp_cnt, total_imp, ads_click_cnt, total_click,
            ads_order_cnt, total_order, ads_gmv_usd, total_gmv, total_atc,
            CASE
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Daily Discover') THEN 'DD'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('You May Also Like') THEN 'YMAL'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Cart Recommendation', ...) THEN 'PP'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Global Search', 'Image Search') THEN 'SEARCH'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Games', 'Voucher Master') THEN 'GAME'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Live Streaming', 'Livestream Game') THEN 'LIVESTREAM'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Search Shop') THEN 'SHOP'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Shop Game') THEN 'SHOP_GAME'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('From the Same Shop', ...) THEN 'IN_SHOP'
                WHEN common_feature IN ('Video') THEN 'VIDEO'
                WHEN common_feature IS NULL THEN 'other'
                ELSE 'other'
            END AS scene
        FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
        WHERE grass_region = '<REGION>'
          AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    ) x
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, scene
) oi
    ON t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id
   AND t.grass_region = oi.grass_region
   AND t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
   AND t.entrance <=> oi.scene
```

ads_item_key_metrics 粒度 (item + shop + scene):
```sql
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, scene,
        SUM(ads_imp_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
        SUM(total_imp) AS total_imp,
        ...
    FROM (
        SELECT ... -- same CASE-WHEN scene mapping
        FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
        WHERE grass_region = '<REGION>' AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    ) x
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, scene
) oi
    ON t.item_id = oi.item_id
   AND t.shop_id <=> oi.shop_id
   AND t.grass_region = oi.grass_region
   AND t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
   AND t.entrance = oi.scene
```

### 维度表构建（获取 item-shop keys）

dim_omni_item_shop_attr 从本表提取有广告表现的 item-shop:
```sql
item_shop_keys AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
    WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}'
      AND grass_date = DATE '${ISO_YESTERDAY}'
      AND item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND shop_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

    UNION

    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id
    FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = '${REGION}'
      AND grass_date = DATE '${ISO_YESTERDAY}'
      AND item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND shop_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
```

## Common Aggregations

所有下游消费者都做两级聚合：
1. 内层：从本表读原始行，增加 CASE-WHEN scene 映射
2. 外层：按 (grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, scene) 或 (grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, scene) SUM 聚合

聚合指标：
```sql
SUM(ads_imp_cnt)     AS ads_imp_cnt
SUM(total_imp)       AS total_imp
SUM(ads_click_cnt)   AS ads_clk_cnt
SUM(total_click)     AS total_clk
SUM(ads_order_cnt)   AS ads_order_cnt
SUM(total_order)     AS total_order
SUM(ads_gmv_usd)     AS ads_gmv_usd
SUM(total_gmv)       AS total_gmv
SUM(total_atc)       AS total_add_to_cart_cnt
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 生产写入（每 region 独立任务）

```sql
INSERT INTO mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
SELECT
    item_id, shop_id, common_feature,
    SUM(omni_item_impr_ads_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
    SUM(omni_item_impr_cnt) AS total_imp,
    SUM(omni_item_click_ads_cnt) AS ads_click_cnt,
    SUM(omni_item_click_cnt) AS total_click,
    SUM(omni_ads_order_cnt) AS ads_order_cnt,
    SUM(omni_order_cnt) AS total_order,
    SUM(omni_ads_gmv_usd) AS ads_gmv_usd,
    SUM(omni_gmv_usd) AS total_gmv,
    SUM(omni_atc_cnt) AS total_atc,
    grass_date, grass_region
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_user_exp_common_feature_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID')
  AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
  AND common_feature != 'Platform'
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, common_feature
```

### Snippet 3: add_metric 流程（SG）- LEFT JOIN 补充

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${SCHEMA}.ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily_add_metric__reg_s0_live
PARTITION (grass_date=date'${ISO_YESTERDAY}', grass_region='SG')
SELECT
    t.*,  -- 原表所有字段
    oi.ads_imp_cnt, oi.ads_clk_cnt, oi.ads_order_cnt, oi.ads_gmv_usd,
    oi.total_imp, oi.total_clk, oi.total_order, oi.total_gmv,
    oi.total_add_to_cart_cnt
FROM ${SCHEMA}.ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily_add_metric__reg_s0_live t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, scene,
        SUM(ads_imp_cnt) AS ads_imp_cnt,
        SUM(total_imp) AS total_imp,
        SUM(ads_click_cnt) AS ads_clk_cnt,
        SUM(total_click) AS total_clk,
        SUM(ads_order_cnt) AS ads_order_cnt,
        SUM(total_order) AS total_order,
        SUM(ads_gmv_usd) AS ads_gmv_usd,
        SUM(total_gmv) AS total_gmv,
        SUM(total_atc) AS total_add_to_cart_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id,
            ads_imp_cnt, total_imp, ads_click_cnt, total_click,
            ads_order_cnt, total_order, ads_gmv_usd, total_gmv, total_atc,
            CASE ... END AS scene
        FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily
        WHERE grass_region = 'SG'
          AND grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}')
    ) x
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date, item_id, shop_id, scene
) oi
    ON t.item_id = oi.item_id
   AND t.shop_id = oi.shop_id
   AND t.grass_region = oi.grass_region
   AND t.grass_date = oi.grass_date
   AND t.entrance = oi.scene
WHERE t.grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}') AND t.grass_region = 'SG'
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

```
Upstream:
  mp_paidads.dws_advertise_user_exp_common_feature_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
    (omni 全渠道商品-入口表现数据，粒度为 daily × region × item × common_feature)

Write:
  mkplpaidads_search_ads.omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily

Write pattern:
  - 每个 region 独立任务，INSERT INTO (非 OVERWRITE)
  - 各 region 并行写入对应分区
  - 覆盖地区：
    - QQ workflow: ID, PH, SG, TH, TW, MY, VN (各 1 个独立任务)
    - US workflow: BR (1 个独立任务)
  - 调度: workflows/ads_algo/ads_diagnosis/intermediate_table/omni_core_key_metrics_merge_daily/

Downstream (consumers):
  - dim_omni_item_shop_attr_daily__reg_s0_live (维度表，提取 item-shop keys)
  - ads_seller_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live (qq_with_omni 覆盖写)
  - ads_item_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live (qq_with_omni 覆盖写)
  - ads_advertise_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live (qq_with_omni 覆盖写)
  - ads_*_add_metric__reg_s0_live (增量补充流程)
  - ads_union_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live (最终 UNION ALL 宽表，间接引用)
```
